title: The intersection family of local trace discriminant ideals on an affine open.
statement: For a morphism $f:X\to Y$ of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] and an affine open $U$ of $Y$, define $I_f(U)$ to be the intersection, over every affine open $V\subseteq U$, every $n\in\mathbb N$, and every $\operatorname{Fin}(n)$-basis $b$ of $\Gamma(X,f^{-1}V)$ over $\Gamma(Y,V)$, of the inverse image under $\Gamma(Y,U)\to\Gamma(Y,V)$ of the principal ideal generated by the determinant of the trace pairing in $b$. An intersection over no bases is the unit ideal. This defines an actual ideal by intersection and uses no chosen basis or existence witness.
